source.rationale: The MULTI-WORD-TEAM guard for the offer copy (captain 2026-08-24: live emitted 'escalate to marketing_promotion_sorento team' at 4 real customers in 8 days). Every other build-suggest-offer fixture uses 'customer_service', which is one word once the underscore is a space, so none of them can tell a working prettifier from a missing one. Here the gate hands down 'purchasing_certification' - the real LANE pairing for a certificates lookup (crm_certificates_list -> purchasing_certification in miss-roster-plan). Two claims, derived from the contract before the body was run: (1) the offer sentence names the team with SPACES - 'escalate to purchasing certification team?' - and carries no underscore anywhere in the customer text; (2) the gate's company_team still WINS over the parser's routing.suggested_team ('marketing_product' here, deliberately different), so the prettifier sits after the preference ladder and did not flatten it. The frozen prefix 'would you like me to escalate' is byte-exact, so the parser's regex contract is untouched. Candidate selection, quick_reply, last_result_set and dym_offer are the ordinary single-candidate shapes and are asserted unchanged.
